basic_info.description: Discover this well-maintained 3-unit building nested in the heart of Noe Valley. This fully occupied property features a spacious 1BD/1BA unit with a private deck, fireplace, and hardwood floors. The 2 stylish and efficient studios have high ceilings and great natural light. Each unit has been thoughtfully maintained reflecting pride of ownership.    Complementing the residential units are 3 separate garages. Two are vacant and one is rented for $400/month, adding significant value and convenience for tenants, and owners. Plans for an ADU have been to the city. Situated on a serene street with easy access to Noe Valley's bustling commercial corridor, this property is ideal for investors looking to benefit from consistent rental income in one of San Francisco's most coveted neighborhoods.
